headline: Heavy rain expected 6–8 Nov in southern Thailand. Easing from 10 Nov.

warnings.title: Flood watch, all 14 southern provinces incl. Krabi
warnings.detail: DDPM, 5–9 Nov. Heaviest rain 7–9 Nov. Risk of flash floods, runoff and landslides.

ferries.detail: Ferries can stop when waves exceed 2–3 m. Highest risk 7–9 Nov. Confirm with the operator the day before.

sourceTitle: Nation Thailand: southern provinces on flood alert 5–9 Nov
